source_of_truth: GitHub repository state plus current generated Culinary programme state

preflight_contract: verify owner-confirmed assigned Search limit and protected reserve
verify Culinary-only project identity and credentials
validate policy/relevance/adaptive allocation before live spend
sync canonical Knowledge Core review bridge when authorized
read cumulative state and hard holds before new Search
scheduled_work_units.successor_rule: Routine closed days continue to the next quota-day wake-up. A durable hard hold stops live Search until its explicit resolution contract is satisfied. YT_CUL_6_READINESS_EARNED hands off to a separately bounded YT-CUL-6 readiness reconciliation and never auto-authorizes Atlas promotion, app admission or publication.
scheduled_work_units.retirement_rule: When a hard hold or YT-CUL-6 readiness makes recurring live discovery ineligible, the persisted work-unit state must mark the scheduler HOLD_OR_RETIRE. The cron may remain only as a fail-closed no-live-spend wake-up until a bounded repository change removes, replaces or re-authorizes it.
